prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1219; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The insured vehicle shows scraping and deformation along the right rear quarter panel, with a cracked taillight lens and a bent rear door frame edge. The damage pattern lines up with a sideswipe from a vehicle moving alongside during a lane change, and the marks run in a consistent direction. Repair will involve replacing the taillight assembly, straightening and refinishing the door skin, and blending paint into the adjacent panel. The labor hours requested are in line with the work described. Shop invoices list each operation once, with no duplicated line items. No prior damage to this area has been reported or found in inspection.
